required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 32 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is decision_meta valid JSON and schema_version=1?
Is status APPROVED?
Is mainline project_governance?
Is reverse-agent-iteration@v2 active?
Is task_packet treated as advisory/background only?
Was the previous baseline correctly identified as decision_20260709_context_manifest_sync_closeout_artifact_rework_v1 with audit outcome ACCEPTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS?
Did the previous closeout artifact rework remain accepted, with run_closeout_result.json PASSED and close_round_result CLOSED?
Is the current round limited to context freshness and report body quality?
Does current_context_packet.json initially point to the previous context sync round rather than the closeout rework round?
Does regenerated current_context_packet.json match decision_20260709_post_closeout_context_sync_v1 and round_20260709_post_closeout_context_sync_v1?
Does current_context_packet.json report final_gate_current=true after post-final sync?
Does current_context_packet.json report stale_context_detected=false after post-final sync?
Does post_final_evidence_sync_result.json exist for this round?
Does post_final_evidence_sync_result.json report sync_status=PASSED?
Does post_final_evidence_sync_result.json prove context_generated_after_final_gate=true or an equivalent digest/timestamp-current basis?
Does final_gate_result.json pass for this round?
Does final_gate_result.json report context_domain_awareness.stale_fact_count=0?
Does final_gate_result.json stop warning about stale decision_id and round_id in current_context_packet.json?
Does state_manifest.json remain a governance index and not replace underlying project_state fact sources?
Were current_state.json and task_packet.json left untouched?

Were artifact_index.json, negative_results.json, roadmap/workstreams.json, domains, frontend, workflows, solve_reports, training materials, archives, deletions, blob_store, and databases left untouched?
Does command_plan.json exist and pass for this round?
Does command_plan.json include required pytest, report-summary, execution-log, final-check, run-closeout, and close-round coverage?
Were any omitted or unauthorized commands executed?
Does pytest_result.txt record an explicit pytest command and exit code 0?
Does pytest include tests/test_project_context.py?
Does pytest include tests/test_project_gate.py?
Do execution_log.json and pytest_result.txt agree on command execution and current IDs?
Does run_closeout_result.json pass and close the current round?
Does round_manifest exist for round_20260709_post_closeout_context_sync_v1 and agree with live reports?
Do execution_report.md and codex_execution_report.md agree on decision_id, round_id, status, acceptance_recommendation, tests_ran, and generated_artifacts?
Does the Required Audit body avoid placeholder answers and future-tense claims?
